title: Special Zoning for Austin's Historic Properties
summary:
*   Austin leaders unanimously approved special "Historic" (H) zoning for five properties, marking a commitment to preserving the city's architectural heritage.
*   The approved changes will protect various residential and commercial buildings, including the McCallum House, Pearl House Saloon, and Finks-Coffey House.
*   The special meeting swiftly concluded after brief public hearings, with all five historic zoning requests receiving full support.
